leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface that defines the structure of a backoff strategy
Implement a concrete class that satisfies the backoff strategy interface
Apply type annotations to enforce proper return types for backoff calculation methods
Configure interface properties to control delay behavior and retry limits
Initialize a backoff strategy instance with specific configuration values
Manipulate the backoff state to calculate progressive delay intervals
Integrate the typed backoff strategy into a simulated retry mechanism
